name: Bract
description: Bracts: modified leaves shingling round a head, each one overlapping the next.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2%; top: 16%; width: 50%; height: 68%; border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 48%; top: 16%; width: 50%; height: 68%; border-radius: 999px 0 0 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
